anomalies.description: A black car enters the intersection and collides with a motorcycle, throwing the rider and motorcycle onto the road surface.

A person is lying motionless on the road in the central intersection area, near a white car that appears to have stopped abruptly; debris is scattered nearby, indicating a recent collision involving a pedestrian.
A motorcycle crashes in the intersection; the rider is thrown and lies motionless on the road while the motorcycle slides to a stop nearby.

A person on a motorcycle approaches and stops near the motionless individual on the ground; the rider dismounts and leans over the person, with posture suggesting possible interaction or aggression toward a helpless victim.
A motorcycle lies on its side in the intersection, with a person lying motionless nearby; a dark sedan is seen swerving sharply just before this frame, suggesting it was involved in the collision.
A person on foot approaches the downed motorcyclist lying in the intersection and appears to strike or kick them repeatedly while others observe; the victim remains motionless throughout.

A dark SUV on the left side of the road collides with a larger vehicle (likely a truck or bus) traveling ahead in the same lane, resulting in a violent impact that ejects debris and causes the SUV to spin and disintegrate.

A dark-colored sedan collides violently with the rear-left side of a stationary white bus, causing significant deformation of the car's front and generating smoke/dust; the impact occurs at approximately 67.0 seconds and the aftermath (smoke, damaged vehicles) is visible through 69.0 seconds.
